methods.fork_order: Top 20 UPDATED_AT, 20 PUSHED_AT, 5 STARGAZERS (20-star request returned 5xx) and two named direct forks. Deduplicated by full name. REST branches?per_page=30 once per repo. Compared each unique tip to prior pinned main SHA; eight branch pages reached the 30-ref cap.
methods.targeted: Separate PR searches scoped to repo:morluto/rea is:pr, terms game / animation / asset format / replay, first 15 per search. Four selected by game-specific titles and relevance; checked actual head.repository.parent, PR files, licenses and HEAD comparison with pinned main. PR comparisons include merged/shared history differences; a positive count does not establish authorship.
